column3: athāsya vratopetasya parṇaśākhām ācchaiti prāṅ vodaṅ vā vācaṃyamo yatra vā vetsyan manyate ||
sā yā prācī vodīcī vā bahuparṇā bahuśākhāpratiśuṣkāgrā bhavati tām ācchinatti iṣe tvā ūrje tvā iti ||
tayā vatsān apākaroti vāyava stha upāyava stha iti ||
athaiṣāṃ mātṝḥ prerayati devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe āpyāyadhvam aghniyā devabhāgam ūrjasvatīḥ
dhruvā asmin gopatau syāta bahvīr iti yajamānam īkṣate ||
athaitāṃ śākhām agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya pūrvayā dvārā prapādya jaghanena gārhapatyam agniṣṭhe .nasyuttarārdhe
yady u vai na saṃnayati barhiḥ pratipad eva bhavati ||
atha jaghanena gārhapatyaṃ tiṣṭhann asidaṃ vāśvaparśuṃ vādatte devasya tvā savituḥ prasave .śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo
gārhapatye pratitapati pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātayaḥ iti tris ||
athāhavanīyam abhipraiti preyam agād dhiṣaṇā barhir accha manunā kṛtā svadhayā vitaṣṭā ta āvahanti kavayaḥ purastāt devebhyo
iha barhir āsade iti vediṃ pratyavekṣate ||
atha tāṃ diśam eti yatra barhir vetsyan manyate ||
darbhastambaṃ parigṛhṇāti yāvantam alaṃ prastarāya manyate devānāṃ pariṣūtam asi iti ||
athainam ūrdhvam unmārṣṭi varṣavṛddham asi iti ||
asidenopayacchati devabarhir mā tvānvaṅ mā tiryak parva te rādhyāsam iti ||
ācchinatti ācchettā te mā riṣam iti ||
ācchedanāny abhimṛśati devabarhiḥ śatavalśaṃ viroha iti ||
sahasravalśā vi vayaṃ ruhema ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśate ||
kṛtvā prastaraṃ nidadhāti pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhi iti ||
tūṣṇīm ata ūrdhvam ayujo muṣṭīn lunoti ||
trīn vā pañca vā sapta vā nava vaikādaśa vā yāvato vālaṃ manyate ||
atha trir anvāhitaṃ śulbaṃ kṛtvāpasalair āveṣṭayati adityai rāsnāsi iti ||
tasmin prastaram abhisaṃbharati susaṃbhṛtā tvā saṃbharāmi iti ||
granthiṃ karoti pūṣā te granthiṃ grathnātu iti ||
sa te māsthāt iti paścāt prāñcam upagūhati ||
athainad udyacchate indrasya tvā bāhubhyām udyacche iti ||
śīrṣann adhinidhatte bṛhaspater mūrdhnā harāmi iti ||
etyottareṇa gārhapatyam anadhaḥ sādayati devaṃgamam asi iti ||
tad uparīva nidadhāti yatra guptaṃ manyate ||
atha tathaiva trir anvāhitaṃ śulbaṃ kṛtvaikaviṃśatidārum idhmaṃ saṃnahyati yat kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā prāviśas tvaṃ vanaspatīn tatas
vedaṃ karoti vatsajñuṃ paśukāmasya mūtakāryam annādyakāmasya trivṛtaṃ tejaskāmasyordhvāgraṃ svargakāmasya ||

eṣa eva veda etan mekṣaṇam etad barhiḥ ||
